基於 Unity 設計於遊戲開發常用的系統工具組，皆為獨立工具，需要什麼安裝什麼.message: A Unity-based toolkit of standalone systems commonly used in game development — install only what you need, with multi-platform support

皆為獨立工具系統，透過 UPM 可單獨安裝、單獨使用，需要什麼裝什麼，彼此互不強.message: Every system is an independent tool that can be installed and used separately via UPM — take only what you need, no forced coupling, plug and play.

涵蓋遊戲開發常用系統：日誌、無限列表、動作序列、紅點通知、輸入控制、補間動畫、時.message: Covers the everyday systems of game development: logging, infinite scroll view, action sequences, red-dot notices, input control, tweening, time, object pooling, saving, localization, and more — no wheel reinventing. Supports Win, OSX, Android, iOS, and WebGL.

高內聚低耦合，各系統透過簡潔 API 進行操作，並附有完整 Example 與.message: Highly cohesive and loosely coupled — each system is operated through a concise API and ships with complete Examples and AI Agent Skills, improving readability and maintainability.
